dedupe_keys.name: an r pipline for cleaning district heating measurment data

description: An R Pipline for Cleaning District Heating Measurment Data is a model or code deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Christian Macher (Know-Center GmbH). This pipline employs various statistical and ML techniques to attempt to detect anomalies and and gaps in timeseries data, in particular measurment data from district heating systems, and perform imputation. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2022. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
